approval_scope: User approved the paired observed-action/normalized-zero-action entrypoint, frozen sampling manifests and step0 checks only; this does not supersede future training gates in the prospective study plan.
sampling: One 3200-draw JSON per seed shared by both arms; private CPU torch.Generator, lexicographic groups -> sorted episode IDs -> original train window list position; three scalar randint calls per draw including singleton levels. Manifests freeze before any model construction; zero optimizer updates.
normalization: Load immutable saved train-only statistics; unchanged dataset constructor independently recomputes for equality validation, never writes or replaces statistics.
evaluation: All1086 train and500 validation windows exactly once per seed/arm, sorted episode IDs and original within-episode order, episode-homogeneous batches <=16; frozen eval models, inference-only; shared persistence common support must equal original all-valid target bytes.
primary: Per-validation-episode normalized8D state MAE, equal episode macro then descriptive mean/population std across three seeds. Step0 random differences are mechanics only; never choose seeds/checkpoints or infer action utility.
secondary: Unchanged native masked SmoothL1 (visual1 + state0.25, beta1), sufficient-sum/count micro metrics; per episode/horizon/view/state coordinate/same-unit metrics and absolute/relative changes; macro RMSE means mean episode RMSE, not pooled RMSE.
recovery: Exclusive fresh output; preserve started/failure artifacts, no overwrite or automatic retry/resume. Inspect PID and logs after interruption; successful step0 must not be rerun automatically.
